verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a merchant path for selling inside chat. Sellers onboard to ACS from the Dashboard, publish a CSV catalog feed, and get approval from each agent. Buyers can "complete purchases without leaving the conversation", and each completed order arrives as a checkout.session.completed event tagged with the originating agent. ACP is implemented first by ChatGPT, with Stripe as the first compatible payment processor. Missing for 10: evidence of live checkout in Claude, Gemini, Copilot or other named surfaces beyond ChatGPT; general availability (ACS is private preview and limited to US/CA/select EU, the custom integration requires a waitlist, ChatGPT listing requires an application, and only physical goods are supported); independent hands-on corroboration.
